implementation_summary: Correction for CHK-BE-501-UNIT (EV-0082). The tests now expect the Hindi label table that BE-709 registered. Imported hi from labels/hi.js. The test 'labelsFor returns the English, Hindi and Tamil tables without fallback' now checks labelsFor('hi') (Hindi table, no fallback) and expects labelLanguages().sort() to be ['en','hi','ta']. The fallback loop now skips the languages in labelLanguages() instead of hardcoding en and ta. That set is pinned to exactly ['en','hi','ta'] by the test above. Every other DocumentLanguage must still fall back to English (fallback true, requested = lang, language 'en', labels = en). No assertion was weakened.
evidence: vitest run of packages/core/tests/audit-doc-render.test.ts: 23/23 passed. The 2 tests that failed in EV-0082 now pass.
risks: The fallback loop's exclusion set comes from labelLanguages(). It stays strict because the previous test pins labelLanguages() to exactly ['en','hi','ta']. Adding a new language table means updating that expectation.
handoff: Test-only change; no source changes. The test now covers the Hindi table (BE-709) and requires an English fallback for every other DocumentLanguage.
